Compute composite team form score

Source: R/features.R
team_form_score.Rd

Combines multiple performance metrics into a single 0-100 score. Higher scores indicate better recent form. This simplifies betting rule thresholds compared to multi-factor conditions.

Usage

team_form_score(
  rolling_gf,
  rolling_xg = NULL,
  elo,
  weight_goals = 0.3,
  weight_xg = 0.5,
  weight_elo = 0.2
)

Arguments

rolling_gf

Numeric. Rolling average goals for.

rolling_xg

Numeric. Rolling average xG for (optional, uses goals if NA).

elo

Numeric. Current Elo rating.

weight_goals

Numeric. Weight for goals component (default 0.3).

weight_xg

Numeric. Weight for xG component (default 0.5).

weight_elo

Numeric. Weight for Elo component (default 0.2).

Value

Numeric. Form score in range 0-100.

Details

The default weights prioritize xG (50%) over goals (30%) and Elo (20%), reflecting that xG is more predictive of future performance.

Examples

# Strong team: high goals, high xG, high Elo
team_form_score(2.5, 2.8, 1750)
#> [1] 86.66667

# Average team
team_form_score(1.2, 1.3, 1500)
#> [1] 43.66667

# Weak team
team_form_score(0.8, 0.7, 1300)
#> [1] 25.66667
